issue.title: [implementation-audit-fixes 04/23] Reject item mutations in archived databases (#83)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #319

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-83-implementation-audit-fixes-04-23-reject-thr_gczr63vyv2` to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #83: item and relation mutations are now rejected once their database is archived.

- Introduced one reusable guard in the choke-point data layer (`backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/chokePoint.ts`) that returns a canonical `403 database_archived` instead of the previous generic `400 validation_failed`.
- Applied it to every item mutation (create, property patch, soft delete, restore) and to both sides of relation create/update/delete.
- Item creation carries the one explicit exception the issue calls for: a replay of an idempotency key that already committed a row before archival returns that existing row with no write and no side effects; a new key, or a key reservation whose row is missing, still gets `database_archived`.
- Reads and restoring the database itself remain unaffected, as required.
- Extended `backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/itemsStore.ts` with a read-only `findIdempotentReplay` helper backing that carve-out.
- Updated/added tests in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/chokePoint.test.ts` covering archived create/update, soft-delete/restore, relation mutations from either side, and the idempotent-replay-vs-new-key behavior.

Verified with a fresh `pnpm install` in `backend`: unit tests (83/83), integration tests across all packages/modules/services (406/406), e2e tests (5/5), the dependency-boundaries check, and a full workspace TypeScript build all pass.

Relay-Step-Status: pass

Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #319

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully to branch `bb/relay-83-implementation-audit-fixes-04-23-reject-thr_gczr63vyv2`.

The remote had advanced with a merge from `develop` since the last push; I fetched, rebased my code-review fix commit on top of it cleanly, re-ran the `chokePoint.test.ts` integration suite (20/20 passing) to confirm nothing broke, and pushed the result.

## Summary

This push contains the code-review fix for PR #319: the relation-mutation test now also exercises `updateRelation` and `deleteRelation` (not just `createRelation`) once item A's database is archived, matching the coverage already present for the item-B-archived side. All three relation mutations are verified to reject with `403 database_archived` from either side of the pair.

This issue was resolved by #319, which just merged into develop.
